examples.description: Check a detached receipt: the certificate's signature and the certificate without it

description: Check an Apier receipt and get each finding separately. Free and keyless: no API key, no credits. Pass { receipt } (the compact JWS in the certificate's `signature` field) and, for Apier's detached form, { payload } (the certificate without `signature`). The result has seven findings under `findings`: signature, signing_key (current, retired, revoked, unknown or sandbox), environment, log_inclusion, anchor, format_version and recorded_result. Each stands alone and there is no overall verdict. A sandbox receipt is checked against the public sandbox key, reads environment sandbox and never `verified`. `notes` says what an intact receipt does not show: internal authority, board resolutions and legal effect. No register lookup is made. Failure mode: VALIDATION_FAILED for a receipt that is not a compact JWS, or a detached one sent without its payload. REST twin: POST /api/v1/public/receipts/verify. No sandbox mirror; a sandbox bearer runs this keyless path. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/check-receipt
description_nb: Sjekk en Apier-kvittering og få hvert funn for seg. Gratis og nøkkelfritt: ingen API-nøkkel, ingen kreditter. Send { receipt } (den kompakte JWS-en i sertifikatets felt signature) og, for Apiers løsrevne form, { payload } (sertifikatet uten signature). Svaret har sju funn under findings: signatur, signeringsnøkkel, miljø, logg, forankring, formatversjon og registrert resultat. Hvert funn står for seg, og det gis ingen samlet konklusjon. En sandkassekvittering sjekkes mot den offentlige sandkassenøkkelen og merkes sandbox. Verktøyet gjør ingen registeroppslag. Nøkkelfri tvilling i REST: POST /api/v1/public/receipts/verify. Ingen sandkassespeil; under en sandkassenøkkel kjøres den nøkkelfrie veien.

payload.description: For a detached JWS (Apier's form, with an empty middle segment): the signed object WITHOUT its `signature` field. Leave out for an attached JWS.

receipt.description: The compact JWS: the `signature` field of the certificate, evidence pack or notary record, unchanged.
